late_sprite.cause: Scheduled foreground OnCommand runs after compile_live finalizes overlay kinds. An initially textureless Sprite compiles as Kind::Actor. Header's later On.Load sets correct texture, dimensions and visibility, but publication previously ignored Kind::Actor forever.
late_sprite.fix: During live publication, an existing Kind::Actor slot whose owned native class is Sprite uses the existing Late(0) resolver. An ordinary texture binding promotes that slot to Kind::Sprite, without rerunning commands or changing AFT kinds.

Crossing the foreground start beat publishes the loaded texture resource and 854x85 geometry.
The warmed composer emits exactly one 854x85 Sprite and its texture handle resolves to header.png.
Repeated publication does not rerun On; LOAD_COUNT remains 1.
